entries.title: gh auth login — GitHub CLI manual
entries.note: Documents the interactive web-flow and the --with-token non-interactive variant, plus the prompt sequence (host, protocol, auth method).

entries.title: gh auth — Authenticate with GitHub
entries.note: Top-level auth command surface; shows how login is the bootstrap entry point separate from configuration.

entries.title: aws configure — AWS CLI Command Reference
entries.note: Bracketed-default prompt convention ([None] / [us-east-1]); ENTER preserves existing value; idempotent re-run pattern.

entries.title: Setting up the AWS CLI
entries.note: End-to-end onboarding walkthrough: key, region, output format. Configuration file written to ~/.aws/config.

entries.title: Configuration and credential file settings — AWS CLI
entries.note: Defines how the configure command writes to ~/.aws/config and ~/.aws/credentials; precedence rules for env vs file.

entries.title: mise activate — mise-en-place CLI reference
entries.note: Activation hook command; `eval "$(mise activate zsh)"` pattern is the model we borrow for `mcpm shell-init`.

entries.title: Getting Started — mise
entries.note: Per-shell install snippets (bash/zsh/fish/powershell); echoes the exact line to append; idempotent guidance.

entries.title: mise use — pin tools to a project
entries.note: Creates a `mise.toml` on first use; --pin flag; project-vs-global scope distinction parallels mcpm scope flag.

entries.title: Setup / Hook into your shell — direnv
entries.note: `eval "$(direnv hook bash)"` install line. Notes the importance of hooking AFTER other prompt-mutating tools.

entries.title: direnv — unclutter your .profile
entries.note: Explains the `direnv allow` consent gate after a .envrc appears in a new directory — security pattern mcpm borrows for project trust.

entries.title: terraform init command reference
entries.note: Project-scoped init that is idempotent: writes a .terraform/ dir, a .terraform.lock.hcl, and prints staged sections (Initializing the backend... / providers... / modules).

entries.title: Initialize Terraform configuration — HashiCorp Developer
entries.note: Worked transcript of `terraform init` for a fresh project — staged output, success summary, what to run next.

entries.title: cargo new — The Cargo Book
entries.note: Scaffolds a new package with a Cargo.toml, src/, and a git repo; `--vcs none` and `--quiet` suppress side effects.

entries.title: cargo init — The Cargo Book
entries.note: Init-in-existing-directory variant; respects pre-existing files; refuses to clobber. Model for our --scope project case.

entries.title: pipx ensurepath — pipx docs
entries.note: Shell-config-mutating onboarding step. Edits ~/.bashrc / ~/.zprofile / ~/.zshrc. --prepend / --all-shells options. Idempotent.

entries.title: pipx ensurepath flag reference (Fig.io)
entries.note: Concise enumeration of ensurepath flags including --force; useful contrast for our `mcpm shell-init` design.

entries.title: Sign in to your 1Password account manually — 1Password Developer
entries.note: `op account add` interactive prompts (sign-in address, email, secret key, password); --account shorthand for non-interactive use.

entries.title: Use 1Password CLI with multiple accounts
entries.note: Arrow-key account selector at signin time; pattern for choosing among many possible default values.

entries.title: npm-init — npm Docs
entries.note: Defines the canonical `-y` / `--yes` flag: skip the questionnaire and accept defaults; we adopt the same flag semantics verbatim.

entries.title: pnpm init — pnpm
entries.note: Deliberately non-interactive by default; pnpm chose `-y` is implicit. Argument for mcpm: don't force prompts when defaults are fine.

entries.title: kubectl config set-context — Kubernetes
entries.note: Per-flag setup (no single interactive `init`); model for the `mcpm config set` non-interactive escape hatch.

entries.title: kubectl config use-context — Kubernetes
entries.note: How kubectl picks which context to use — file-based, no per-command prompt. Lesson: cache the choice, don't ask twice.

entries.title: Poetry — Basic usage / poetry init
entries.note: Interactive pyproject.toml builder; bracketed defaults; every prompt is skippable. Mid-2020s gold standard for project-scaffolding TUIs.

entries.title: stripe login command — Stripe CLI Wiki
entries.note: Device-flow pairing-code pattern and `--interactive` flag for no-browser key entry — directly applicable to a CLI-only auth UX.

entries.title: Stripe CLI Reference
entries.note: Overview of the Stripe CLI's bootstrap commands; pairs with login to set up local state.

entries.title: Command Line Interface Guidelines
entries.note: Source for: idempotence ("running twice is safe"), confirm-before-destructive, --force escape hatch, conversational > inquisitive prompts.

entries.title: cli-guidelines/cli-guidelines on GitHub
entries.note: Canonical source repo for clig.dev; community-maintained CLI design principles.

entries.title: XDG Base Directory Specification (freedesktop.org)
entries.note: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME / $XDG_STATE_HOME / $XDG_CACHE_HOME — where mcpm writes config (config), service state (state), and download cache (cache).

entries.title: XDG Base Directory — ArchWiki
entries.note: Application-author-facing summary with macOS deviation notes (apps frequently fall back to ~/.config on macOS by convention).

entries.title: Ratatui — Rust crate for terminal user interfaces
entries.note: The TUI library underlying the mcpm wizard; widget composition, event loop, theme handling.

entries.title: tui-prompts — beautiful prompts for ratatui
entries.note: Drop-in prompt widgets (text input, password, select) for ratatui; candidate library for the mcpm init wizard.

entries.title: Comparison of Rust CLI Prompts: cliclack, dialoguer, promptly, inquire
entries.note: Survey of Rust prompt libraries with screenshots. Useful for picking the non-ratatui fallback path (when stdout isn't a TTY).

entries.title: Elevate Your CLI Tools with @clack/prompts
entries.note: Modern prompt-UX patterns: conservative escapes, intro/outro framing, cancel handling. We borrow the intro/outro framing for mcpm init.

entries.title: A launchd Tutorial
entries.note: LaunchAgent vs LaunchDaemon distinction; `launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u)` modern command; per-user plist location.

entries.title: systemd user — Arch Linux Wiki
entries.note: `systemctl --user enable --now mcpd.service` pattern; lingering for headless persistence; XDG_RUNTIME_DIR socket binding.

entries.title: Sunsetting Create React App — React Blog
entries.note: Cautionary tale: a `create-*` scaffolder loses momentum if init becomes a maintenance burden. Argues for thin-init, fat-doctor.

entries.title: CLI: create-next-app — Next.js Docs
entries.note: Modern interactive scaffolder; "use defaults?" yes/no shortcut before per-question prompts. Pattern: one umbrella default-accept before per-item prompts.
